step1.title: The Sphere
step1.body: The sphere expands on the inhale and contracts on the exhale. Breathe to its rhythm. Tap it to start a session.

step2.title: Protocol
step2.body: Rounds (3 by default), each with inhale-exhale cycles, then a breath retention (hold).

step3.title: Breathing phases
step3.body: INHALE — breathe in, EXHALE — breathe out, HOLD — retention. The RELEASE button ends the hold early.

step4.title: Settings
step4.body: Rounds, cycles, inhale/exhale/hold durations. Sound: ambient, breath, heartbeat, ticks — volume per channel.

step5.title: Presets
step5.body: Save your configurations as presets and load them with one tap — inside the protocol settings.

step6.title: Sequences
step6.body: "My sequences" — your own protocols with different parameters for each round.

step7.title: Journal & stats
step7.body: The journal is your session history. Stats shows charts and insights for your breathing practice.

step8.title: Start
step8.body: INITIATE PROTOCOL to begin. A 5-second countdown → breathing cycles → retention → completion and reflection.

complete.title: COURSE COMPLETE
complete.body: The breathing protocol is mastered. Calm is your strength, operative.
